description:
Approval is a human decision on one operation. It matches only on the
operation's uid and intent digest, never on its name.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: ApprovalSpec is a human decision bound to one operation uid and intent digest.

authTime.description:
AuthTime is the login time the apiserver reported for that user
(userInfo.extra["delivery.pacto.trianalab.io/auth-time"], RFC 3339 or Unix seconds).

by.description: By must equal the apiserver username of whoever created the Approval.

decision.description: Decision is what a human approval says.

groups.description:
Groups must equal the groups of whoever created the Approval. The
promoter accepts it only when one of them names a team the question
was routed to.

operation.description: Operation is the operation's name, for people. Matching uses the uid.

record.description:
Record names the keyless approval record this Approval is a view of.
Only the recorder sets it.

signedAt.description:
SignedAt is the verified signing time of that record (RFC 3339).
Only the recorder sets it.

status.description: Status names the approval's signed record. Only the recorder writes it.

record.description: Record is the approval's signed record, once the recorder wrote it.

digest.description: Digest is the record id: the sha256 of its signed payload.

ref.description: Ref is where it is: <repository>@<manifest digest>.
